module clock_div2 (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output clk_out
);

always @(posedge clk or posedge rst)
begin
    if (rst == 0) begin
        clk_out <= 0; // Assuming 0 when RST is low
    end
    else begin
        clk_out <= ~clk_out; // Toggle output on each clock edge
    end
end

endmodule

module piso_8bit(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input load,
    input [7:0] pin,
    output reg sout
);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            sout <= 1'b0;
        end else if (load) begin
            for (integer i = 8 downto 1) begin
                sout <= pin <<= {1'b1, sout};
            end
        end else begin
            for (integer i = 8 downto 1) begin
                dout <= pin <<= {1'b1, sout};
                dout[4] <= dout[7];
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

  input clk,
  input enable,
  input S,
  input A,
  input B,
  input C,
  output reg Z
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (S == 1) begin
      // Reset state
      Z <= '0;
    end
    else if (enable) begin
      // State transitions as defined
      if (Z == 0) begin
        Z <= A;
      end
      else if (Z == 1) begin
        Z <= B;
      end
      else if (Z == 2) begin

            if (B && C <= 2'b11) begin
                Z <= 4'b0011;           // Set Z to 0011
            end else begin
                Z <= A##B|A##C;         // Z = (A XOR B) OR (A XOR C)

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input shift_ena,
  input count_ena,
  input data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (count_ena) begin
    q <= {q[0:1], data}; // Shift right with new data entering at q[0]
  end
  if (shift_ena) begin
    q <= {q[1: 0], q[3:2]}; // Circular shift left
  end
end

endmodule

    z <= y[0];
  end
end

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output out_sop,
  output out_pos
);

always @(a or b or c or d) begin
  // Determine the sum bit for full adder
  if (((a || b) && !(c || d)) && (!((c || d) && (c || a || b)))) begin
    out_pos <= 1'b1; // Sum bit
  end else begin
    out_pos <= 1'b0; // Zero
  end

  // Determine the carry bit for full adder
  if (((a || b) && (c || d)) || ((a || b) && c || (c || d) || a) || (b || c || d)) begin
    out_sop <= 1'b1; // Carry bit
  end else begin
    out_sop <= 1'b0; // Zero
  end
end

endmodule

module instr_reg (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input [1:0] fetch,
    input [7:0] data,
    output [2:0] ins,
    output [4:0] ad1,
    output [7:0] ad2
);

always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        ins <= 0;
        ad1 <= 0;
        ad2 <= 0;
    end
    else begin
        if (fetch == 2'b00) begin
            ad1 <= data[3:0]; // Lower 4 bits of data in ad1
            ad2 <= data[7:0]; // Full data in ad2
            ins <= 0;     // Ins is updated later
        end
        if (fetch == 2'b01) begin
            ins <= data[7:4]; // Upper 4 bits shifted into lower positions
        end
    end
end

endmodule

module synchronizer(
	input 				clk_a	, 
	input 				clk_b	,   
	input 				arstn	,
	input				brstn   ,
	input		[3:0]	data_in	,
	input               data_en ,

	output reg  [3:0] 	dataout
);

    // Declare internal registers for pipelined synchronization
    reg [3:0] data_reg_1;
    reg [3:0] data_reg_2;
    reg        data_en_reg;

    // Process for handling clock_a based logic and clock edge synchronization
    always @(posedge clk_a or negedge arstn or negedge brstn) begin
        if (!arstn) begin
            dataout <= data_reg_1; // Copy from previous stage
            if (data_en) begin
                data_reg_1 <= data_in;
                data_en_reg <= 0; // Reset data enable flag
            end
        end else begin
            dataout <= 4'b0;      // Reset output on active reset
            data_reg_1 <= 4'b0;
            data_en_reg <= 0;
        end
    end

    // Process for handling clock_b based logic and clock edge synchronization
    always @(posedge clk_b or negedge arstn or negedge brstn) begin
        if (!arstn) begin
            data_reg_1 <= data_reg_2; // Transfer data from second stage for future stage
            if (data_en) begin
                data_reg_2 <= data_reg_1; // Update second stage register
                data_en_reg <= 0;         // Reset enable flag again if needed
            end
        end else begin
            dataout <= 4'b0;    // Reset output on active reset
            data_reg_1 <= 4'b0;
            data_en_reg <= 0;
        end
    end

    // Output assignment delayed by one clock cycle after becoming valid
    always @(posedge clk_a or negedge arstn or negedge brstn) begin
        if (!arstn) begin
            data_en_reg <= 1;    // Set data start flag on input
        end
    end

endmodule
